changes: Excerpt: the section “Aging and Disease” and the first two paragraphs of “Can We Slow Aging?”. Headings, abstract, figures and reference numbers removed.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Slowing aging could keep people healthy for longer.
Small dogs are always healthier than horses.
Older people should stop eating so many calories.
questions.explain: "if researchers found a way to make aging run at a slower pace, people would stay healthier for longer" гэж бичсэн. Энэ бол текстийн гол санаа.

questions.prompt: What happens when mice eat 30%–40% fewer calories?
options: They get sick much more often.
They grow bigger than other mice.
questions.explain: Калорийг 30–40%-иар багасгахад "can extend their lifespan by about 30%-40%" гэж бичсэн. Өөрөөр хэлбэл илүү удаан амьдардаг.

questions.prompt: What does “postpone” mean in the text?
questions.explain: Текстэд "postpone (delay)" гэж хаалтанд тайлбарласан. Хойшлуулах гэсэн утгатай.
